components: Leader/follower replication: submits a versioned mutation
Leader/follower replication: orders or coordinates writes
Leader/follower replication: stores a durable copy
Leader/follower replication: selects a freshness level

steps: The client submits v4 to the current leader.
The leader orders it at log index 30.
Followers receive and apply the entry in log order.
Reads use the leader or a follower that meets the requested freshness.

lesson.scenario: A database leader appends an account update and two followers replay its ordered log.
entities: Orders writes in the replication log

steps.title: Replicated baseline
steps.narration: All replicas have applied log index 104.
steps.outcome: The group exposes the same committed state.
steps.invariant: Only the leader assigns positions to new writes.

steps.title: Leader appends
steps.narration: The leader appends balance=65 at index 105.
steps.outcome: The update is not yet acknowledged as committed.
steps.invariant: Followers replay the leader’s log order.

steps.title: Synchronous follower persists
steps.narration: F1 writes index 105 and returns a durable acknowledgement.
steps.outcome: A configured acknowledgement quorum is reached.
steps.invariant: The leader must wait for the promised durability policy before success.

steps.title: Commit acknowledged
steps.narration: The leader advances commit index and responds to the client.
steps.outcome: Leader and F1 can serve committed version 105.
steps.invariant: A lagging follower must not present its state as current.

steps.title: Async follower catches up
steps.narration: F2 replays index 105 from the leader stream.
steps.outcome: All followers converge on the committed prefix.
steps.invariant: Failover may choose only a sufficiently up-to-date follower.
